chapter: Split, hospital and decline of tap
title: Running home and his mother teaching him the Pretty Foot
summary: Green runs home laughing, and his mother, who read his mind, tells him he is huffing like doing the Pretty Foot and shows him the step that leads to the hobbler.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
